headline: 🔑 768 AWS root keys still live, 💳 Apollo Global breach hits SSNs, 🔓 Spring Security CVSS 10 LDAP flaw, 🤖 DeepSeek AI automates exploits, 🕵️ Grok zero-click prompt injection, 🦠 LockBit claims U.S. Bank
summary: 768 active AWS root keys with full admin access remain exposed across public repositories, Apollo Global discloses a breach exposing SSNs, and Spring Security patches a CVSS 10.0 LDAP flaw in a batch of 91 advisories. A Chinese threat actor demonstrates end-to-end AI-assisted exploitation using DeepSeek, and researchers show zero-click prompt injection exfiltrating Grok chat history.
